description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio Pause functionality, using Google Test framework. It tests the behavior of pausing the WebAudio player, including success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: WebAudioPauseTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudio Pause tests, setting up mock objects for GstWebAudioPlayer and its client.

methods.name: shouldPause
methods.description: Test case verifying that the pause operation successfully changes the pipeline state to PAUSED.

methods.name: shouldFailToPause
methods.description: Test case verifying that if changing the pipeline state to PAUSED fails, the client is notified of failure.
